subject: Kickoff: FNet low-cost encoder track (Q2)
body:
Team — kicking off the FNet productionization track.

Why we care: FNet swaps every self-attention sublayer for an unparameterized Fourier transform, which makes it a natural fit for the low-cost encoder tier data-platforms wants to offer — near-Transformer quality at a fraction of serving cost.

Plan inside the Q2 window: (1) env bring-up and the f_net unit-test suite green by Mar 31; (2) the C4 pre-training run in early June on our TPU reservation; (3) GLUE fine-tuning matrix by Jun 15; (4) launch review before Jun 22.

Ownership: Hyun modeling, Kaia the pre-training config, Nikhil evals, Jorge infra. Jelena will follow up on the compute picture. First sync Thursday 10:00.

Dmitri
